Callout.Name: Vehicle Fire - Roadside
Callout.Message: Car alight on the hard shoulder, occupants out.
Callout.Advisory: Occupants well clear, traffic passing slowly.

Script.Line: It went up while I was driving it. I got out at the lights.
It runs on gas. There is a tank in the back of it.
I am insured. Just tell me what to do and I will do it.

Lines.Approach: Everybody is out of it and standing well back. Traffic is slowing to look, which is its own problem.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
